languageScope: Four requested locales checked in actual screens; other existing game languages preserved. Chinese means Simplified Chinese, not a Traditional Chinese review.
productionAccess: Approved according to owner; this is not proof that a production release is published.

operatorActions.required: Upload only the signed LIVE .aab from the verified release artifact. Choose supported countries/regions, release notes and rollout percentage. Review pre-launch reports before rollout.

Add the four locale listings from these text files; review screenshots and localize their text without changing game/shop design. zh-CN does not establish availability in mainland China. Other store languages are not prepared in this change.

Confirm actual target age groups. Current code does not implement an age screen or child-directed / under-age ad flags. If children are included, review Families rules and implement the appropriate ad/consent handling before worldwide publication.

Declare advertising ID use truthfully. Inspect all active tracks, including older internal-test packages; an old package can keep the global warning present even when the new AAB has AD_ID. Remove/replace invalid old active artifacts as appropriate. Re-enable release-error protection after every active package is compliant.

Confirm data collection/sharing, purpose, encryption/deletion disclosures against actual Google Mobile Ads, UMP and Play Games behavior and account configuration. Declare contains ads; complete content rating, app access and target audience truthfully. Virtual-crystal shop is not proof of real-money IAP.

Confirm the public URLs respond without login after Pages deploy. Test support mailbox and complete a real deletion request; a mail link alone does not establish that the operational deletion workflow has been fulfilled.
Link the public Play store listing, complete app readiness review, check Policy center/serving restrictions, and configure payment identity/tax/payment method in the account.

Verify the published UMP messages and languages for applicable EEA/UK/Swiss and US-state requirements in AdMob. Test choices/reopening on registered test devices; code tests do not prove which regional messages are published.
Serve the exact publisher line at https://mhmtbsr60.github.io/app-ads.txt (domain root), then trigger/check AdMob verification. The repository file under /KaraDugum/ alone is insufficient.
Resolve Console policy tasks including trader/non-trader status for applicable distribution regions; provide accurate support details.

Install the TEST APK as an update over an existing save, validate cloud account/reward video/consent on a physical device, and review Play pre-launch crash/ANR reports. Never click live ads for testing.

sourceChecks.ads: UMP SDK controls ad eligibility; required consent/options forms block ad requests, rewarded coupons originate only from completed durable receipts, interstitials only at next-level transitions with a minimum two-minute / three-transition cadence.
sourceChecks.saveCompatibility: No changes to the 300-level generator, save keys/schema, hint accounting, cloud merge or economy. Locale affects display text only.
sourceChecks.manifest: AD_ID explicitly declared in canonical source manifest; CI must check merged manifest and bundletool output from the signed LIVE AAB. Use the artifact verification report and SHA-256 for the actual binary, not this checklist.
sourceChecks.sdk: Resolved SDK graph is pinned and exported by CI; no claim about every future SDK policy notice or private Console warning.
sourceChecks.minification: R8 is disabled. No mapping.txt is expected; the release collector includes it if R8 is enabled later.

reviewLimit: Technical checks are evidence, not a Google policy approval, account access, physical-device certification or a revenue guarantee.

publicChecksBeforeDeployment.note: Public legal documents were reachable before this release; translations must be rechecked after Pages deployment. Production access approval does not make the store listing public.
